item.title: Political traffic signals: waiting for the light to change on the Hill
item.summary: Congress faces a steep political battle over a $200 billion Iran war spending request, with Trump sending mixed signals on whether the funds are needed.

item.title: Iran conflict tests Pakistan amid own border clashes as Islamabad touted as venue for US-Tehran talks
item.summary: Pakistan, the only nuclear-armed Muslim state, faces mounting pressure as its Saudi defense pact and Iran ties clash amid the intensifying regional war.

item.title: Trump's death will be 'like Mardi Gras in New Orleans,' Charlamagne warns after Mueller post
item.summary: Radio host Charlamagne Tha God warned President Donald Trump that people will celebrate his death "like Mardi Gras" after he celebrated Robert Mueller's death.

item.title: Bill Cosby found liable for 1972 sexual assault, jury awards $19M to accuser
item.summary: A Santa Monica jury found fallen comedian Bill Cosby liable of drugging and sexually assaulting Donna Motsinger in 1972, and awarded the former waitress more than $19 million in damages.

item.title: NJ man crawls through window, attempts to sexually assault girl before being subdued by resident: police
item.summary: A New Jersey resident is being credited with stopping a horrific home invasion after subduing a suspect who allegedly tried to sexually assault a sleeping girl.

item.title: Johnson turns up heat on Schumer as DHS shutdown drags on, airport delays mount
item.summary: As the DHS shutdown enters its sixth week, House Republicans are forcing votes to pressure Senate Democrats. Meanwhile, unpaid TSA agents call out, leaving travelers facing chaos.

item.title: 300-plus Angel Families jump into Markwayne Mullin’s DHS nomination fight in unequivocal terms
item.summary: Over 300 Angel Families represented by The American Border Story are urging Congress to support Markwayne Mullin for DHS, arguing he understands the stakes at play.

item.title: Macaulay Culkin’s fiancée Brenda Song’s airline nightmare sparks debate after first-class seats given away
item.summary: Brenda Song claims Alaska Airlines gave away her family's pre-booked first-class seats, separating her and Macaulay Culkin from their young kids.

item.title: Sheriff shrugs off missteps in Nancy Guthrie case, calls for captor to ‘let her go’ as family pleads for help
item.summary: As Nancy Guthrie's disappearance nears two months, her family says "someone knows something" and urges the Tucson community to share tips and video.

item.title: 'Supernatural' actress Carrie Anne Fleming dead at 51
item.summary: Carrie Anne Fleming, known for her roles in "Supernatural" and "iZombie," has died at 51 after a battle with cancer, her representative confirmed.
